# Docuhide

> Docuhide is role-based encrypted document redaction software — real redaction (not masking) with tamperproof authorization, protection at rest and in transit, and patent-pending technology.

## Products

- Docuhide Complete — All office documents; HIPAA, SOX, legal compliance focus.
- Docuhide Milspec — Military-grade encryption; DOD/DOJ-oriented deployments.
- Docuhide Lite — Word and email workflows; mobile and tablet users.
